# Event catalog

<!-- generated by `python3 sdk/gen/catalog.py` from bindings/openrpc.json; do not edit -->

227 subscribable names in 68 topics. Use a name in `plugin.yaml` `subscribe`
(`topic` + `types`) and in `on(name)`. Event `data` is the wire JSON exactly as the feed carries it;
ignore unknown fields and unknown `type`s (design 216 §7.5). Δ marks delta-class types, which need
`deltas: true` on the subscription. Plugin events (`<plugin>.<event>`) come from manifests, not from
this list. The JSON Schema of each topic is in `bindings/openrpc.json` under `x-theuth.events`.

| Name | Version | Δ | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `voice.events#DictationLevel` | 1 |  | RMS per 20 ms of the last 160 ms of mic audio, 0.0–1.0, linear. |
| `voice.events#DictationText` | 1 |  | Text of utterance `utterance` (0-based within this dictation) so far. |
| `voice.events#DictationFinished` | 1 |  | Mic closed. |
| `voice.events#DictationDevice` | 1 |  | The input device changed mid-dictation (153 §8.2): re-armed on `device`, or lost. |
| `voice.events#DictionarySuggestion` | 1 |  | A dictionary suggestion is due (153 §6.3): the surface shows the card. |
| `web.scrape-progress` | 1 |  | Live URLs for one search/scrape/crawl/map call. |
